notes.title: 🐊 Release notes 1.0.9
notes.content: [h1]Release Highlights[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335281/10e7dc715c0c80d3d13d55477cfa99b0dcc98af1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🦖 Features[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Acceleration Structure Compaction[/b][/p][p]Our ray tracing system now supports acceleration structure compaction, a feature designed to reduce memory usage. After an acceleration structure is built, the system can optimize it to occupy less GPU memory while maintaining the same rendering quality and performance.[/p][p]This means more efficient use of graphics resources, leaving additional memory available for textures, larger scenes, and richer visual effects. With compaction, you get the same ray tracing results at a lower memory cost, enabling better scalability and smoother performance across a wide range of hardware.[/p][p]As part of evolutionary benchmarking, we’ll continue updating Evolve with the latest techniques. As such, acceleration structure compaction is now enabled by default. This will slightly affect your acceleration structure build score.[/p][p][/p][h2]✍️ Additional Information[/h2][p]If you’re a member of the press or influencer feel free to use the form on our website ([url="https://www.evolvebenchmark.com/press-influencers#"]https://www.evolvebenchmark.com/press-influencers[/url]) and sign up for a free copy of the professional version![/p]

tags.feature: Our ray tracing system now supports acceleration structure compaction, a feature designed to reduce memory usage.
As part of evolutionary benchmarking, we’ll continue updating Evolve with the latest techniques.
acceleration structure compaction is now enabled by default.

notes.title: 🦖 Release notes 1.0.4
notes.content: [h1]Release Highlights[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335281/4bf8ed87f824ee216f83f036ed5da002d0426a00.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🦖 Features[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Evolve Advanced: Save and upload benchmark results[/b][/h3][p]Evolve Advanced users can now save benchmark results to disk and upload them at a later time, offering enhanced flexibility and control over your benchmarking workflow.[/p][p][/p][p][b][b]Saving benchmark results:[/b][/b][/p][p]To save your benchmark results, use the [b]--result[/b] command-line argument during a benchmark run:[/p][code]./evolve.exe --result path/to/result[/code][p]When the benchmark completes, the results are stored locally as a [b].evolve[/b] file at the specified location.[/p][p]Note: Saving results to disk disables automatic benchmark submission.[/p][p][/p][p][b][b]Uploading saved results:[/b][/b][/p][p]To upload your saved [b].evolve[/b] benchmark results, use the [b]Evolve Offline Submit[/b] tool ([b]evolve-offline-submit.exe[/b]), included with your Evolve installation.[/p][olist][*][p]Navigate to your Evolve install directory.[/p][/*][*][p]Open a command shell.[/p][/*][*][p]Run the following command:[/p][/*][/olist][code]./evolve-offline-submit.exe path/to/result.evolve[/code][p]If the upload is successful, you will receive a link to your uploaded results, making it easy to access and share.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Evolve Advanced: Offline mode[/b][/h3][p]Evolve Advanced users can now run Evolve in offline mode, allowing you to skip authentication and benchmark submissions entirely. This provides greater flexibility for isolated environments or private benchmarking sessions.[/p][p]To launch Evolve in offline mode, use the [b]--offline[/b] command-line argument:[/p][code]./evolve.exe --offline[/code][p][/p][h2]🐞 [b]Bug fixes & improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The benchmark settings menu now shows the selected benchmark mode.[/p][/*][*][p]On desktop, improved alignment of score dials in the benchmark results menu.[/p][/*][*][p]On desktop, improved graph’s “on hover” tool tip visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved stability on Adreno 830 devices. These include the Samsung Galaxy S25 series, Xiaomi 15 series, OnePlus 13 series, and more.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🧜‍♂️ [b]Thank you![/b][/h2][list][*][p]Thanks [b]Albrecht Mesotten[/b] from [url="https://hwbot.org/"]HwBot[/url] for the save and upload feature request![/p][/*][*][p]Thanks [b]Harish Jonnalagadda[/b] from [url="https://www.androidcentral.com/"]Android Central[/url] for the Adreno 830 stability report.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]✍️ [b]Additional Information[/b][/h2][p]If you’re a member of the press or influencer feel free to use the form on our website ([url="https://www.evolvebenchmark.com/press-influencers#"]https://www.evolvebenchmark.com/press-influencers[/url]) and sign up for a free copy of the professional version![/p]

tags.feature: Evolve Advanced users can now save benchmark results to disk and upload them at a later time, offering enhanced flexibility and control over your benchmarking workflow.

Evolve Advanced users can now run Evolve in offline mode, allowing you to skip authentication and benchmark submissions entirely. This provides greater flexibility for isolated environments or private benchmarking sessions.

On desktop, improved alignment of score dials in the benchmark results menu.
On desktop, improved graph’s “on hover” tool tip visibility.
Improved stability on Adreno 830 devices. These include the Samsung Galaxy S25 series, Xiaomi 15 series, OnePlus 13 series, and more.

notes.title: 🦕 Release notes 1.0.3
notes.content: [h1]Release Highlights[/h1][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335281/87391b91c31e5fdd68e04e2411d4145fd6e3b378.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🕺Announcements[/h2][list][*][p]Make sure to check out our [url="https://www.evolvebenchmark.com/technical-guide"]technical guide[/url] for more information on exactly what the scores mean, and on how to set up a repeatable benchmark.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🦖 Features[/h2][list][*][p]New hall of fame page on the evolve website! See [url="https://www.evolvebenchmark.com/hall-of-fame"]https://www.evolvebenchmark.com/hall-of-fame[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335281/b54a5ac26853faedd645cf5d548519d2a468e711.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335281/9218422608fde41fabcd19a658d183d05c2f85ec.png"][/img][/p][h2]🐞 Bug fixes & improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Temporarily disable benchmark interrupts for the Intel driver-configured frame limiter. [i]The bug has been reported to Intel.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Fixes the social media sharing buttons moving outside the results screen for a window that uses letter-boxing.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue with authentication which could lead to users having to re authenticate when it wasn’t necessary.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🧜‍♂️ Thank you![/h2][list][*][p]Thanks [b]Pieter Plaisier[/b] from [url="http://skatterbencher.com"]skatterbencher.com[/url] for reporting the frame limiter issue on Intel![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]✍️ Additional Information[/h2][p]If you’re a member of the press or influencer feel free to use the form on our website ([url="https://www.evolvebenchmark.com/press-influencers#"]https://www.evolvebenchmark.com/press-influencers[/url]) and sign up for a free copy of the professional version![/p]

tags.feature: New hall of fame page on the evolve website! See https://www.evolvebenchmark.com/hall-of-fame

tags.bug: Temporarily disable benchmark interrupts for the Intel driver-configured frame limiter. This was incorrectly giving false positives due to a bug in the intel driver control library, resulting in a benchmark always being interrupted on Intel devices that had this feature set. [i]The bug has been reported to Intel.[/i]
Fixes the social media sharing buttons moving outside the results screen for a window that uses letter-boxing.
Resolved an issue with authentication which could lead to users having to re authenticate when it wasn’t necessary.

notes.title: 🦕 Release notes 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Release Highlights[/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335281/8d49d9310a7495ac4dedbef36504e5f9ed1f1ec6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🕺Announcements[/h2][list][*][p] Thanks for being some of our first users to download and play around with Evolve![/p][/*][*][p] This release going forward requires the use of NVIDIA 565 drivers or higher[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]🐞 Bug fixes & improvements[/h2][list][*][p] On NVIDIA we now report fan speed in RPM rather then as a percentage. Previously we were using an API that would report fan speed as a percentage which would occasionally go over 100% leading to confusion with some of our users.[/p][/*][*][p] On Intel we now collect fan speed in RPM[/p][/*][*][p] On Intel we collect total board power usage (in Watt).[/p][/*][*][p] Crisper UI rendering due to improved anti-aliasing and blending. We were previously interpolating the UI colors in an incorrect color space, leading to incorrect results.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335281/7fe8f9e05d20eb325aa14b498fc6a42bdbd04051.png"][/img][/p][p]Before, image has sharp and pixelated lines

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45335281/70ea0b9b5d5ca98901e290dd405781a3c861a12c.png"][/img][/p][p]After, image has smooth and nicely anti-aliased lines

[/p][h2]🧜‍♂️ Thank you![/h2][list][*][p]Thanks [b]Potato Head[/b] and [b]Albuquerque[/b] from the Beyond3D forums for reporting the odd fan speed behavior on NVIDIA!
[/p][/*][/list][h2]✍️ Additional Information[/h2][p]
If you’re a member of the press or influencer feel free to use the form on our website [url="https://www.evolvebenchmark.com/press-influencers"]https://www.evolvebenchmark.com/press-influencers[/url] and sign up for a free copy of the professional version![/p]

tags.bug: On NVIDIA we now report fan speed in RPM rather then as a percentage. Previously we were using an API that would report fan speed as a percentage which would occasionally go over 100% leading to confusion with some of our users.
On Intel we now collect fan speed in RPM
On Intel we collect total board power usage (in Watt).
Crisper UI rendering due to improved anti-aliasing and blending. We were previously interpolating the UI colors in an incorrect color space, leading to incorrect results.
